disposition: The saved median materially improves absolute error but worsens squared error and totals. This is a location-summary tradeoff, not an improved expected-value candidate or evidence that Steamer reports medians. Preserve current expected PA and the original benchmark goals. Large readiness, participation, availability and conditional-workload errors remain.
next_step: Build a fixed-cohort error budget across public/current MLB and never-debut groups, separating wrong participation allocation, active workload and hitting yield. Reconcile it with completed arrival-allocation, specialized-workload, employment and direct-value results before choosing a structural repair; no generic PA boost, median substitution, record flag or repeated small-feature sweep.

Ohtani/Ozuna/Marte/Harper are outcome-blind controls with actual 727/592/556/580; they do not prove matching injury or talent. Global refined active support of 931 is not 931 Judge analogues.
